summary: The registrant filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly net asset value (NAV) per share as of June 30, 2026. The filing provides a breakdown of total NAV ($1.37 billion) and NAV per share by class ($24.91-$26.15). This is a routine periodic NAV update for a non-traded REIT, not a special situation event. No transaction, activist activity, strategic review, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is present. The filing serves as a standard investor communication.
